dct_title_s: Democratic Republic of the Congo Towns
dct_description_sm: Abstract: The Democratic Republic of the Congo towns from The Multipurpose Africover Database for the Environmental Resources produced by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO). Scale of the dataset: 1:100,000. The towns and major towns shapefiles were developed from data from the National Imagery and Mapping Agency (NIMA).

Purpose: The towns have been included for orientation purposes and should not be seen as comprehensive. Please note that these data might conflict with the Africover data. The purpose of the Africover Project is to establish a digital georeferenced database on land cover and a geographic referential for the whole of Africa including: - geodetical homogeneous referential - toponomy - roads - hydrography The Multipurpose Africover Database for the Environmental Resources (MADE) is produced at a 1:200,000 scale (1:100,000 for small countries and specific areas). Reinforcing national and sub-regional capacities for the establishment, update and use of the geographic referential and land cover maps and spatial data bases is the core strategy of Africover: this has been the methodology adopted to ensure an operational approach and the sustainability of the initiative.
